title: Descent of bounded graded modules and successive maps
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I → CommRingCat a diagram of Noetherian rings, c a limit cone of its spectra with affine apex, i in I, and f:X_i → Spec(R_i) locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Put X=X_i times_{Spec(R_i)} c.pt [def-pc-base-change]. Let M_n be finitely presented quasi-coherent modules on X [pqf-def-coherent], zero outside a fixed integer interval [a,b], with arbitrary successive maps d_n:M_n → M_{n+1}. There is a stage j≥i, modules F_n on X_j, zero outside the same interval, finitely presented and quasi-coherent, maps delta_n:F_n → F_{n+1}, and isomorphisms between their tensor pullbacks and M_n commuting with these maps. No square-zero equation is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Descend only the terms by bounded_graded_family_descent, obtaining j, F and comparisons e_n.
Transport d_n to φ_n = e_n.hom ≫ d_n ≫ e_(n+1).inv between the limit pullbacks of the fixed family F. Apply bounded_graded_map_compatibility to obtain k, G, δ and comparisons t_n commuting with φ_n.

Use t_n ≪≫ e_n as the final comparison. Rewrite the map compatibility equation, reassociate, and cancel e_(n+1).inv ≫ e_(n+1).hom. Retain the support, finite-presentation, and quasicoherence conclusions of the map lemma.

proof_origin.note: P3 complete Lean proof: first descend the terms, then maps between fixed term models; combine by conjugation and cancellation of comparison isomorphisms. Both helpers are proved, so this closes one hole and adds none.

mathlib_searches.query: bounded module-and-map descent; pullback finite presentation
bounded family of finitely presented quasicoherent modules and maps descends along an affine inverse limit; tensor pullback preserves finite presentation
mathlib_searches.results: Only affine-limit section lemmas and the finite-presentation predicates; no matching theorem. Loogle HomologicalComplex query had no results; QuasicoherentData query returned the presentation definitions.

mathlib_searches.query: complex.*descent|descen.*complex; pullback.*IsFinitePresentation|isFinitePresentation_pullback; blueprint searches finite presentation pullback and bounded complex descent
mathlib_searches.results: No matching sheaf family descent theorem. Affine perfect/graded scalar-extension descent requires affine module models and cannot handle possibly nonaffine Xi directly. The upstream isFinitePresentation_tensorPullback supplies preservation of finite presentation; no duplicate preservation module is delivered.

mathlib_searches.query: A finite diagram of finitely presented quasi-coherent sheaves descends to a stage of an affine inverse limit of schemes
mathlib_searches.results: 8 affine-limit global-section and scheme-map lemmas; no matching sheaf-family descent theorem. Independently searched by the X3 second reader.

lean.statement:
theorem bounded_graded_module_map_descent
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ k : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj k)]
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (M : ℤ → (pullback f (c.π.app (op i))).Modules)
    (a b : ℤ) (hM_zero : ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (M n))
    (hM_fp : ∀ n : ℤ, (M n).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hM_qc : ∀ n : ℤ, (M n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (d : ∀ n : ℤ, M n ⟶ M (n + 1)) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
      (F : ℤ → (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules)
      (δ : ∀ n : ℤ, F n ⟶ F (n + 1)),
      (∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (F n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (F n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (F n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
      ∃ e : ∀ n : ℤ,
          (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj (F n) ≅ M n,
        ∀ n : ℤ,
          (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).map (δ n) ≫
              (e (n + 1)).hom = (e n).hom ≫ d n
